title: OneDrive: uninstall the Photos experience without affecting file sync
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned user removal option and the roadmap's promise that OneDrive, file sync and files remain unaffected. Its narrow documentation gaps were confirmed by independent searches; the cited Learn pages opened successfully despite the pre-check's rate-limit responses.
